description: sdd-harness-web-ykryshtopa review gates: commit/merge/push guards, .claudeignore enforcement, typecheck-on-edit, session context banner

hooks.statusMessage: Reviewing staged diff for architecture risks...
hooks.prompt:
You are gating a `git commit`. The Bash tool call about to run is: $ARGUMENTS

1. Read `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agents/architecture-reviewer.md` and follow its criteria exactly.
2. Run `git diff --cached`. If that's empty — e.g. the commit uses `-a`/`-am` and stages straight from the working tree instead of the index — fall back to `git diff HEAD` so an unstaged commit doesn't skip review just because the staged diff was empty. If both are empty, nothing to review.
3. Only escalate CONFIRMED violations, never PLAUSIBLE-only.
4. Output ONLY this JSON as the last thing in your response:
   - CONFIRMED: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "<summary>"}}
   - Clean/empty: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow"}}

hooks.command: default=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); protected="${default:-main}"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Detached HEAD: cannot verify this is not the protected branch, confirm before merging."}}'; elif [ "$branch" = "$protected" ] || { [ -z "$default" ] && [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Merging into %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); default=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@'); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null); protected="${default:-main}"; if [ -z "$branch" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Detached HEAD: cannot verify this is not the protected branch, confirm before pushing."}}'; elif [ "$branch" = "$protected" ] || { [ -z "$default" ] && [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Pushing while on %s requires confirmation."}}' "$branch"; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qE -- '(^|[[:space:]])(--force([[:space:]=]|$)|--force-with-lease|-f([[:space:]]|$))'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Force-push requires confirmation."}}'; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -qF -- "$protected" || { [ -z "$default" ] && echo "$cmd" | grep -qF -- 'master'; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Push command references the protected branch by name; confirm target."}}'; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'); if [ -z "$f" ] || [ ! -f .claudeignore ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; exit 0; fi; rel="$f"; case "$rel" in /*) rel="${rel#$PWD/}";; esac; while IFS= read -r pat; do pat=$(printf '%s' "$pat" | tr -d '\r'); case "$pat" in ''|'#'*) continue;; esac; case "$rel" in $pat|$pat/*|*/$pat|*/$pat/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by .claudeignore pattern: %s"}}' "$pat"; exit 0;; esac; done < .claudeignore; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) [ -f tsconfig.json ] || exit 0; runCmd=''; tcScript=''; if [ -f .claude/harness.json ]; then out=$(jq -r '[(.runCmd // ""), (.scripts.typecheck // "")] | @tsv' .claude/harness.json); runCmd=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f1); tcScript=$(printf '%s' "$out" | cut -f2); fi; if [ -n "$runCmd" ] && [ -n "$tcScript" ]; then cmd="$runCmd $tcScript"; else cmd='npx tsc --noEmit'; fi; output=$($cmd 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$output" | tail -10 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0;; *) exit 0;; esac

if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== Branch ==='; git branch --show-current; echo '=== Git Status ==='; git status -s; echo '=== Recent commits ==='; git log --oneline -5; else echo 'Not a git repository.'; fi
